The human and AI continue discussing their AI project with Peter at Caroline's Café on January 13th, 2026. Peter shares new ideas for the project and suggests discussing them during their next meeting at the same location on Tuesday at 3 PM. Samantha agrees, bringing treats for the stray animals and seeds for the community garden, while Peter offers vegan street tacas as usual after the meeting.

Peter also mentions that he will attend Samantha's gig the following week. Later that evening, the human encounters Andy at the gym, who is invited to join their next AI project meeting the next day at Caroline's Café at 3 PM. Andy accepts, planning to meet for vegan street tacos afterwards and bringing seeds for the community garden. Samantha and Andy also arrange for Samantha to bring treats for the stray animals. Andy looks forward to the meeting and the catch-up with old times.

Their updated schedules include new commitments for both Samantha and Peter. Samantha has a dinner with Samantha pending on October 17th, 2025, a catch up with Andy for coffee on October 20th, 2025, a play attendance with Peter on October 24th, 2025, and a catch up with Caroline on October 30th, 2025, in addition to the previously scheduled meetings with the AI project team members.
